meta._json_run_notes: Updated 4 highest-gap nationwide orgs from matrix-assist-orgs.php using live site verification April 2026. Focused on intake paths, secure channels, addresses, and verbatim nationwide evidence. Matrix values used as baseline only.
meta._json_run_researcher_notes: Prioritized GAP (intake evolution), Whistleblower Aid (SecureDrop addition), Signals Network (ProtonMail + grants), and NWC (address shift). All records meet essential fields and nationwide scope. Several ternary/empty fields left as sentinels per prompt for human resolution.

identity.general_description: Government Accountability Project is a nonpartisan nonprofit organization founded in 1977 that promotes government and corporate accountability. It provides legal representation, advocacy, and support to whistleblowers exposing wrongdoing. The organization litigates cases, publicizes concerns, and works to strengthen whistleblower protections across sectors.

scope_of_service.nationwide_example: Government Accountability Project is the nation’s leading whistleblower protection organization. Through litigating whistleblower cases, publicizing concerns and developing legal reforms...
scope_of_service.protected_class_details: Serves federal employees, private sector/corporate staff, and nonprofit employees; broad coverage implied but not exhaustively listed by class
scope_of_service.whistleblower_note: Government Accountability Project has empowered over 8,000 whistleblowers with legal protection and advocacy expertise.

contact.mailing_address: Government Accountability Project, 1612 K St NW, Suite 808, Washington, DC 20006

review._review_notes: Intake via dedicated CiviCRM online form qualifies under Intake Commitment Rule (case review offered). No dedicated secure tool (standard form only). Protected classes use has-details as site implies broad but does not list exact taxonomy matches.

identity.general_description: Whistleblower Aid is a nonprofit legal organization providing free assistance to public and private sector workers who wish to safely and lawfully disclose wrongdoing. It offers holistic support including legal counsel, media coordination, and retaliation defense. The organization emphasizes secure and anonymous initial contact methods.

scope_of_service.nationwide_example: Whistleblower Aid is a pioneering non-profit legal organization that helps public and private sector workers report and expose wrongdoing — safely, lawfully, and responsibly.
scope_of_service.protected_class_details: Government employees and private-sector/corporate staff; broad whistleblower support without narrow class restrictions stated
scope_of_service.additional_services: Holistic support model including psychological counseling references
scope_of_service.whistleblower_note: Whistleblower Aid is a pioneering non-profit legal organization that helps public and private sector workers report and expose wrongdoing — safely, lawfully, and responsibly.

contact.mailing_address: Whistleblower Aid, 1250 Connecticut Ave NW, Suite 700, Washington, DC 20036

review._review_notes: Secure options expanded: SecureDrop with Tor for full anonymity + Signal. secure_contact_tool set to 'other' per schema limit (multiple tools). Intake page clearly offers personal assistance path.

identity.general_description: The Signals Network is a nonprofit organization providing holistic support to whistleblowers who disclose information in the public interest. Services include legal assistance, psychological counseling, financial grants, physical security, and media coordination. It works with whistleblowers and journalists globally while maintaining a strong US presence.

scope_of_service.nationwide_example: TSN is a whistleblower support organization that exists to help support the brave whistleblowers who come forward for the public good.
scope_of_service.protected_class_details: Broad support for whistleblowers across sectors; no narrow employee class restrictions listed
scope_of_service.additional_services: Psychological support, financial grants via Whistleblower Protection Fund, physical security assistance
scope_of_service.whistleblower_note: TSN's Whistleblower Protection Program aims to help whistleblowers navigate the legal, physical, psychological and economic consequences of speaking out.

contact.mailing_address: The Signals Network, 416 Florida Ave NW #26152, Washington, DC 20001

review._review_notes: Secure contact via ProtonMail confirmed. Additional PGP option noted but not mapped. Services include mental-health and financial support not fully captured by core slugs.

identity.general_description: The National Whistleblower Center advocates for whistleblower rights, educates the public and policymakers, and assists whistleblowers in accessing legal aid and protections. It operates a referral program and provides resources on whistleblower laws and rewards.

scope_of_service.nationwide_example: NWC is the leading nonprofit dedicated to protecting and rewarding whistleblowers around the world.
scope_of_service.protected_class_details: Broad support across all sectors; assists whistleblowers worldwide with US focus
scope_of_service.whistleblower_note: The National Whistleblower Center (NWC) is the leading nonprofit dedicated to protecting and rewarding whistleblowers around the world. We assist whistleblowers in finding legal aid, advocate for stronger whistleblower protection laws...

contact.mailing_address: National Whistleblower Center, 1800 M Street NW #33888, Washington, DC 20033

review._review_notes: Intake via general contact form and separate attorney referral; report-fraud-now.info appears more tip-oriented and does not qualify as personal assistance intake per rule (left empty). Address updated from matrix based on current site.
